notes: *it is the litter* is divided under rule 20: the impersonal *it* is added, since rule 20's construction-supplied dummy is the presentative *there* and no other, and the copula joins the predicate noun.

*of Solomon* is placed on the לְ of שֶׁלִּשְׁלֹמֹה, leaving the relative unrepresented under rule 22. Two competing readings were available and not taken: giving the *of* to the relative instead, and fusing שֶׁ + לְ into one unit under rule 30 on the analogy of אֲשֶׁר בּוֹ → *wherein*, headed on the relative by rule 23.
*about it* gives the whole adverbial word to סָבִיב and leaves the לְ unrepresented, on rule 40's סָבִיב לַמִּשְׁכָּן precedent.
